description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for interacting with a build API in an Android CI environment, including methods for fetching build IDs, downloading artifacts, and managing API errors.

classes.name: BuildAPIError
classes.description: Represents an error response from the build API with a message and code.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuildAPI
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the BuildAPI interface for interacting with Android CI build API endpoints.

methods.name: GetLatestGreenBuildID
methods.description: Retrieves the latest successful build ID for a specified branch and target.

methods.name: DownloadArtifact
methods.description: Downloads a specified artifact for a particular build and target.

methods.name: getSignedURL
methods.description: Fetches a signed URL for downloading an artifact.

methods.name: doGETToWriter
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a URL and writes the response body directly to a writer.

methods.name: doGETToJSON
methods.description: Performs a GET request and decodes the JSON response into the provided object.

methods.name: doGETCommon
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request, adding authorization if credentials are set, and handles error responses.
